preconditions.description: The number of rows must be greater than 0.
The number of columns must be greater than 0.

postconditions.description: The number of rows in the returned board matches the input rows.

postconditions.expression: all(len(row) == columns for row in return_value)
postconditions.description: Each row in the returned board has the same number of columns as the input columns.

postconditions.expression: all(all(cell in {'O', 'X'} for cell in row) for row in return_value)
postconditions.description: Each cell in the returned board contains either 'O' or 'X'.

postconditions.expression: all(all(row[col] == ('O' if (row_idx + col_idx) % 2 == 0 else 'X') for col in range(columns)) for row_idx, row in enumerate(return_value))
postconditions.description: The returned board represents a chessboard pattern with 'O' starting from the top-left corner.
